findings.title: budgetManagement gate skipped for empty project list
findings.problem: get_cost_center_budget_summary() returns CostCenterBudgetSummary(budgets=[]) at the early return for an empty project_names list (line 263-264), before the ensure_budget_management_enabled() call added at line 266, so that path never reaches the new chokepoint.
findings.impact: A cost center that resolves to zero linked projects (via GET /v1/admin/cost-centers/{id}/budget-rollup) returns 200 with an empty summary instead of the 403 every other budgetManagement-disabled call receives, materially deviating from the spec's explicit 'checked before it returns any figures, so a future second caller cannot bypass it by construction' requirement for this chokepoint. No test combines an empty project list with the flag disabled.
findings.recommendation: Move the ensure_budget_management_enabled() call above the `if not project_names` early return so the gate is checked unconditionally before any return path, and add a test covering the empty-list path with budgetManagement disabled.
findings.check_notes: ensure_budget_management_enabled() moved to line 263, above the empty-project_names early return; new test confirms 403 for empty list + disabled flag.

fix.change: Moved ensure_budget_management_enabled() above the `if not project_names` early return in get_cost_center_budget_summary() so the gate runs unconditionally before any return path.

final_round.rationale: CR-001 (critical): the new budgetManagement chokepoint in get_cost_center_budget_summary() sits after the empty-project_names early return, so a cost center with zero linked projects returns 200 instead of 403 when budgetManagement is disabled, deviating from the spec's explicit 'checked before any figures are returned, bypass-proof by construction' requirement. Deferred 2 pre-existing budgetManagement enforcement gaps outside this diff's named scope: user_management_router.py's per-user budget endpoints and servicenow_integration_service.py's direct project_budget_service calls bypass the flag entirely, with no gate at all, before and after this diff. 5 findings dismissed as below the blocking floor or explicitly out of scope (a service-layer/FastAPI import matching existing precedent, a CONFIG_IDS string-duplication style nit, chargeback's cross-flag dependency on costCenters which the spec names as a non-goal tracked separately, costCenters CRUD already gated via cost_center_service.ensure_feature_enabled, and an untested-but-non-bypassing auth-ordering corner case); the UI portion of AC1-AC3 is explicitly out of scope for this backend-only run per the task.
